sentences.text:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK ROSHAN ---------
For the Petitioner(s) : Ms. Sunita Kumari, Advocate For the Opposite Party(s) : Mr. Rajesh Kumar,
APP ---------
07/Dated: 10th November, 2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The instant bail application has been preferred by the petitioner for grant of regular bail in connection with Sursang, P.S. Case No. 10 of 2022, corresponding to Special POCSO Case No. 49 of 2022 for the offences registered under Sections 366-A IPC, pending in the Court of learned Special Judge POCSO, Gumla.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he has falsely been implicated in this case.

She further draws attention of this court towards the deposition of the victim and submits that by going through paragraph 1 of the deposition it clearly transpires that no offence of 376 IPC has been committed by this petitioner, however, the petitioner has been charge sheeted for 376 also.

She further submits that the petitioner is in custody since 21.06.2022 and out of 6 witnesses only 3 witnesses have been examined till date, as such he may be enlarged on bail.
4.
Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for bail and submits that the girl was minor at the time of incidence and she has supported the prosecution case.

5. Having regard to the facts of the case and the allegation made in the F.I.R. coupled with the deposition of the victim, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail at this stage. Accordingly,
